/ Key facts: AMZN fuels AI capex surge; Evercore $355; 600MW Gennaker PPA
Key facts: AMZN fuels AI capex surge; Evercore $355; 600MW Gennaker PPA
Amazon (AMZN) is a hyperscaler fueling AI data-center capex growth. Industry spending may jump from ~$125B (2021) to ~$700B (2026); AMZN’s capex and financing mix are central.
Evercore lifted AMZN 12-month target to $355 from $315, citing survey: 92% online reach, 49% same-day delivery use, Prime same-day buyers spend 3.1x more, 46% add perishables.
AMZN signed a 600 MW power purchase deal for the Gennaker offshore wind farm in Germany, supplying carbon-free power expected to cover over one million homes once operational.
